chapter: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

quests.title: Weighty Wings

dialogue.t: Ugh, you're... tougher than you look...
Gah. Who did we offend... Who'd send someone on this day, of all days, to come whack us...
Please, Big Bro(Big Sis). How have we offended you? Just... let us know. We won't do it again.
Hey, you little rascal! You're really gonna grovel before this piece of work?
You think talking tough's going to make us a living? I can see it now, I tell you. We're just living like thieves and crooks. There's nothing special about trafficking Saurians, is there?
If the only alternative's being robbed by a stronger crook, why shouldn't I go with them instead?
And not to brag, Big Bro(Big Sis), but I'm sure I'd be way more useful to you than these two. Just call me if you need anything. I'll settle it, nice and clean.
Hmm?

dialogue.sit: Well, I do happen to be shopping about for a sidekick.
Thanks for your consideration, but no need.

dialogue.t: Are you serious!? No way! Paimon vetoes this motion!
Also, you're a bunch of bad eggs anyway! No way good guys like us would team up with Saurian traffickers like you!

dialogue.sit: Yup, there's no one good-er than me.
Well, there's always room for accommodation.

dialogue.t: Ahem! Anyway, whatever designs you have on the Saurians, better stop now, or we'll... Well, {NICKNAME} will show you what's what.
Rawr!

dialogue.sit: The two traffickers leave amidst a cloud of resentment...

dialogue.t: Paimon wonders how that Qucusaurus is doing. Shall we go see to it?
Roar...
Oh no, it looks so weak... It must have suffered so much...
Wooo... Rrrooo...

dialogue.sit: If only there was something we could do to help...
We can't take care of it forever, can we...

dialogue.t: Rrah... Rawr! Raaawr!
What is it? Do you have an idea, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?
Rawr!
(It looks incredibly weak. If only there was some way to revive it...)
Raaawr! Rawr!
Do you think Embercore Flowers might help it out?
Rawr!
Sure, we can give it a go!
Rawr... Rawr!
Looks like it's kinda reinvigorated?
Heh. Flew away just like that... Guess it still doesn't trust us, huh?

dialogue.sit: Trust isn't built overnight, you know.
Looks like it'll fly on its own power just fine.

dialogue.t: That's true. We had to work hard to reach the understanding we've got with {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} too!
Rawr! Rawr rawr!
And it's not like we did it to earn its gratitude or anything, don'cha think, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?
Rawr!
Hehe, you're a generous little Saurian, aren't you? Just like Paimon and {NICKNAME}!

quests.description: You find an injured Saurian out in the wild…
